attachments.origin_landmark: lateral surface of the zygomatic bone, in front of zygomaticus major
attachments.insertion_landmark: upper lip lateral to the philtrum

actions: elevates the upper lip, deepening the nasolabial furrow

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Contributes to the sneer, and to exposing the upper teeth in a full smile.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
